trap_forwarding_rules.trap_explanation: An SNMP trap is an immediate message sent by a network device when something happens. A rule copies a trap FireISP receives to the one destination you choose.

trap_forwarding_rules.setup_hint: Configure each network device to send SNMP traps to this FireISP server's trap listener. The default listener is UDP port 1620 unless your deployment maps standard UDP port 162. Docker Compose publishes it only on loopback by default; set SNMP_TRAP_PUBLISH_IP to the firewall-protected management IP. For a bare-node install, use SNMP_TRAP_BIND_IP instead. Rules can only route traps FireISP actually receives.

sessions.title: Subscriber sessions
sessions.help: RADIUS accounting links an authenticated subscriber account to assigned addresses, access server, timing, and usage. It does not provide NAT translation evidence.

attribution.title: Case-bound IP attribution
attribution.help: Use an exact public address and instant to find one retained subscriber/access-session assignment. Shared CGNAT addresses also require the source port and transport protocol.
attribution.restrictedHelp: Each lookup is permission-controlled, audited, and bound to a validated government request. There is no general mapping browser.
attribution.caseHelp: The case must be an IP-traceability request in Processing status with an official reference, legal basis, and exactly the same authorized lookup values.
attribution.timezoneHelp: Enter the instant to the second. It will be sent as UTC using your browser timezone ({{timezone}}).
attribution.notPersonProof: This result attributes a retained network assignment to a subscriber account and access session. It does not prove which person used the connection or any act by that person.
attribution.planScope: A service plan controls address-pool assignment only; it is not attribution evidence.

validation.caseRequired: Enter a valid government request ID.
validation.ipv4Invalid: Enter a valid public IPv4 address.
validation.portInvalid: Enter a public source port from 1 to 65535.

readiness.title: Evidence readiness
readiness.subtitle: Operational signals only—not a legal-compliance certification. Verify every source before relying on an attribution.
readiness.error: Logging readiness could not be checked.
readiness.sessionsGuidance: Configure RADIUS accounting start, interim, and stop messages on every access server, then confirm recent events arrive.
readiness.sessionsReceiving: Recent subscriber accounting is arriving. Check source coverage whenever access servers are added or changed.
readiness.attributionGuidance: Configure every direct-address and CGNAT egress source to send assignment or mapping evidence with synchronized clocks and loss reporting. Enabled CGNAT exporter configurations require authoritative_baseline_confirmed and a nonblank baseline_reference; every CGNAT event requires session_instance_id. Missing coverage, time accuracy, or records prevents reliable attribution.
readiness.attributionReceiving: Recent attribution evidence is arriving. Receiving data alone is insufficient: coverage, clock, metadata, and loss indicators must also be complete. Keep authoritative_baseline_confirmed, baseline_reference, and each event's session_instance_id complete.
readiness.attributionRestricted: Attribution readiness is restricted. Subscriber accounting remains available separately.
readiness.retentionGuidance: Confirm both cleanup windows match the organization's approved legal and privacy schedule.
readiness.sessionRetentionBelowBaseline: Subscriber-session retention is {{months}} months, below FireISP's 24-month Mexico policy baseline. Confirm the organization's approved legal schedule before relying on these records.
